history.full_name: TKR College of Engineering and Technology (TKRCET)

society.name: TKR Educational Society
colleges: TKR College of Engineering and Technology (TKRCET) - Autonomous
TKR Institute of Management and Science (TKRIMS)

admissions.process: Admissions are through TS EAPCET counseling for B.Tech, PGCET for M.Tech, and direct admission for MBA. Visit the admissions office or website for detailed procedure.
admissions.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics for B.Tech. Graduation in relevant field for M.Tech/MBA.
admissions.contact: Visit https://tkrcet.ac.in/admissions for admission details and fee structure.

facilities.main: State-of-the-art labs, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi campus, digital library, hostel (boys & girls), transport, sports ground, auditorium, NCC, incubation center, and medical facilities.
facilities.special: Virtual labs, R&D center (21,000 sq ft), industry partnerships with ECIL and others.

transport.details: TKRCET provides a fleet of buses connecting all major parts of Hyderabad city to the campus. Transport is safe, reliable, and available for both students and staff.
transport.routes: Buses operate from Dilshuknagar, LB Nagar, Secunderabad, Uppal, Mehdipatnam, Kukatpally, and other key areas.
transport.contact: For specific route map and fee details, please visit the Transport Section in the Administrative Block.

canteen.name: College Canteen
canteen.description: The college canteen provides hygienic food, snacks, and beverages at subsidized rates. It is a clean and spacious area where students can relax and refuel.
canteen.menu: South Indian, North Indian, Chinese snacks, and beverages.
canteen.timings: Open during college hours (including lunch break).

ncc.name: National Cadet Corps (NCC)
ncc.description: TKRCET has an active NCC unit that instills discipline, leadership, and patriotism.

nss.name: National Service Scheme (NSS)
nss.description: The NSS unit organizes blood donation camps, village adoption programs, and environmental awareness campaigns.

fees.btech: Tuition fee for B.Tech is approximately Rs.85,000 - Rs.1,00,000 per year (depending on the quota and branch).
fees.mtech: Tuition fee for M.Tech is approximately Rs.57,000 per year.
fees.mba: Tuition fee for MBA is approximately Rs.50,000 per year.
fees.hostel: Hostel fee is roughly Rs.70,000 - Rs.80,000 per year (including food and accommodation).
fees.transport: Transport fee varies by route, typically between Rs.20,000 to Rs.35,000 per year.

events.annual_day: Celebrated with cultural programs and award distributions.
events.sports_meet: Organized annually covering cricket, basketball, volleyball, athletics, etc.
events.upcoming_events: For information about upcoming events, please check the college website, notice boards, or contact the Student Activities Office.
